comment: Labelled requirements for the precision tests: pairs listed under duplicates say the same thing, pairs under conflicts contradict each other (with the kind). Every other pair of the same corpus is unrelated. Hard negatives (related topic, different statement) are deliberate.

docs.title: User login
docs.description: The user MUST be able to sign in with their e-mail address and password.

docs.title: Log in with email
docs.description: Users SHALL log in using their email address and a password.

docs.title: Log out
docs.description: The user MUST be able to sign out from every page.

docs.title: Account lockout
docs.description: The system SHALL lock the account after 5 failed login attempts.

docs.title: Lock account after failed attempts
docs.description: After five unsuccessful sign-in attempts the user account MUST be locked.

docs.title: Unlock by administrator
docs.description: An administrator MUST be able to unlock a locked account.

docs.title: Password length
docs.description: Passwords MUST be at least 12 characters long.

docs.title: Maximum password length
docs.description: Passwords MUST be at most 8 characters.

docs.title: Password reset
docs.description: The user MUST be able to reset a forgotten password by e-mail.

docs.title: Search response time
docs.description: The search page MUST respond within 2 seconds.

docs.title: Slow search
docs.description: The search page SHALL respond in no less than 5 s.

docs.title: Report generation time
docs.description: Monthly reports SHOULD be generated within 10 minutes.

docs.title: Export reports to PDF
docs.description: The user MUST be able to export reports as PDF.

docs.title: No PDF export
docs.description: The user MUST NOT be able to export reports as PDF.

docs.title: Export to CSV
docs.description: Lists SHOULD be exportable to CSV files.

docs.title: Audit logging
docs.description: Audit logging MUST be enabled by default.

docs.title: Audit logging default
docs.description: Audit logging MUST be disabled by default.

docs.title: Audit log retention
docs.description: Audit log entries SHALL be kept for 7 years.

docs.title: Two-factor authentication
docs.description: Administrators MUST use two-factor authentication.
details: An administrator cannot sign in without a second factor.

docs.title: MFA for admins
docs.description: Multi-factor authentication SHALL be mandatory for administrator accounts.

docs.title: MFA optional for users
docs.description: Multi-factor authentication MAY be offered to ordinary users.

docs.title: Nightly backup
docs.description: The database SHALL be backed up every night.

docs.title: Backup encryption
docs.description: Backups MUST be encrypted.

docs.title: Unencrypted backups
docs.description: Backups MUST be unencrypted so that they can be restored anywhere.

docs.title: Session timeout
docs.description: A session MUST time out after at most 15 minutes of inactivity.

docs.title: Long sessions
docs.description: Sessions MUST stay active for at least 30 minutes without activity.

docs.title: Dark mode
docs.description: The user interface SHOULD offer a dark colour scheme.

docs.title: Keyboard navigation
docs.description: Every function of the UI MUST be reachable with the keyboard.

docs.title: Delete account
docs.description: A user MUST be able to delete their own account.

docs.title: Remove own user account
docs.description: Users SHALL be able to remove their account themselves.

docs.title: Password storage
docs.description: Passwords MUST NOT be stored in plain text.

docs.title: Hashed passwords
docs.description: Passwords MUST be stored as salted hashes.

docs.title: API latency
docs.description: The API MUST respond within 500 ms.

docs.title: Nightly import
docs.description: The nightly import MAY take at least 2 hours.

docs.title: Användarinloggning
docs.description: Användaren ska kunna logga in med e-post och lösenord.

docs.title: Inloggning
docs.description: Brukaren ska logga in med sin e-postadress och sitt lösenord.

docs.title: Utloggning
docs.description: Användaren ska kunna logga ut från alla sidor.

docs.title: Kontospärr
docs.description: Systemet ska spärra kontot efter 5 misslyckade inloggningsförsök.

docs.title: Spärra konto efter misslyckade försök
docs.description: Efter fem misslyckade försök att logga in ska användarkontot spärras.

docs.title: Upplåsning av administratör
docs.description: En administratör ska kunna låsa upp ett spärrat konto.

docs.title: Lösenordslängd
docs.description: Lösenord ska vara minst 12 tecken.

docs.title: Korta lösenord
docs.description: Lösenordet får vara högst 8 tecken långt.

docs.title: Återställ lösenord
docs.description: Användaren ska kunna återställa ett glömt lösenord via e-post.

docs.title: Svarstid för sök
docs.description: Söksidan ska svara inom 2 sekunder.

docs.title: Långsam sökning
docs.description: Söksidan ska ha en svarstid på minst 5 sekunder.

docs.title: Rapportgenerering
docs.description: Månadsrapporter bör tas fram inom 10 minuter.

docs.title: Export av rapporter till PDF
docs.description: Användaren ska kunna exportera rapporter som PDF.

docs.title: Ingen PDF-export
docs.description: Användaren får inte kunna exportera rapporter som PDF.

docs.title: Export till CSV
docs.description: Listor bör kunna exporteras till CSV-filer.

docs.title: Granskningslogg
docs.description: Granskningsloggen ska vara aktiverad som standard.

docs.title: Granskningslogg som standard
docs.description: Granskningsloggen ska vara avstängd som standard.

docs.title: Lagring av granskningslogg
docs.description: Poster i granskningsloggen ska sparas i 7 år.

docs.title: Tvåfaktorsautentisering
docs.description: Administratörer ska använda tvåfaktorsautentisering.

docs.title: MFA för administratörer
docs.description: Flerfaktorsautentisering ska vara obligatorisk för administratörens konto.

docs.title: Frivillig MFA
docs.description: Vanliga användare får erbjudas flerfaktorsautentisering.

docs.title: Nattlig säkerhetskopia
docs.description: Databasen ska säkerhetskopieras varje natt.

docs.title: Kryptering av säkerhetskopior
docs.description: Säkerhetskopior ska vara krypterade.

docs.title: Okrypterade säkerhetskopior
docs.description: Säkerhetskopior ska vara okrypterade så att de kan återställas var som helst.

docs.title: Tidsgräns för session
docs.description: En session ska avslutas efter högst 15 minuters inaktivitet.

docs.title: Långa sessioner
docs.description: En session ska vara aktiv i minst 30 minuter utan aktivitet.

docs.title: Mörkt läge
docs.description: Gränssnittet bör erbjuda ett mörkt färgschema.

docs.title: Tangentbordsnavigering
docs.description: Alla funktioner i gränssnittet ska nås med tangentbordet.

docs.title: Radera konto
docs.description: En användare ska kunna radera sitt eget konto.

docs.title: Ta bort eget användarkonto
docs.description: Brukare ska själva kunna ta bort sitt konto.

docs.title: Lagring av lösenord
docs.description: Lösenord får inte lagras i klartext.

docs.title: Hashade lösenord
docs.description: Lösenord ska lagras som saltade hashvärden.

docs.title: API-svarstid
docs.description: API:et ska svara inom 500 ms.

docs.title: Nattlig import
docs.description: Den nattliga importen får ta minst 2 timmar.
